description: This file defines the RootShell widget, which serves as the main authenticated shell with bottom navigation for the attendance tracking app. It manages navigation between Dashboard, Attendance, and Reports screens, displays user information, and provides a logout action.

classes.name: RootShell
classes.description: The main widget for the authenticated user interface, with bottom navigation and user info display.

classes.name: _RootShellState
classes.description: State class managing navigation state, user data, and rendering of content.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for RootShell.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including Scaffold with AppBar, body, and BottomNavigationBar.
